summary: Iteration 85 – tested the 3 new System Health features (SLA Targets, Analytics Trend sparkline, Select Across Filters) plus optimization regressions (nav prefetch, branding upload, admin downloads) for Obserra SAP UAC. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passing (SLA config GET/PUT, per-room SLA PUT+clear, analytics trend, bulk-status-filter, 4 admin downloads, auth gating). Frontend: SLA panel org save persists (48→verified via GET), room override 24 shows 'effective 24h (override)' + Use default reverts to 'effective 48h (org default)'. Trend row renders with 'Weekly median: Not enough history yet' and sparkline element present. Select all reveals bulk bar ('3 selected'), Select across link switches to 'All matching requests selected' and Apply -> POST bulk-status-filter returns 200 {updated:1}. Filter change clears selection. Normal bulk-status works too. Branding modal opens, image upload + Save returns 200 (toast 'Audit Room branding saved'). Left-nav clicks navigate correctly to SoD, Identities, Workflow Activity, System Health (hover-prefetch does not block clicks). Final state restored: org_sla_hours=72, both room overrides null, at least 1 open audit request retained.
